#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
#
# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
#
# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
#
# Derived fields:
#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
#
# Usage:
#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
#
# Options:
#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
#                      bad row naming its line number
#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  row written / file valid
#   1  --validate found a bad row
#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
#
# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,62p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
  esac
done

STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'

# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
  n=0 bad=0
  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue
    err="$(jq -r --argjson st "$STATUSES" --argjson ungraded "$ALLOW_UNGRADED" '
      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"
                       elif t(.[k]; ts) | not then "field \(k) has type \(.[k] | type), want \(ts | join("|"))"
                       else empty end;
      def num: ["number"]; def numn: ["number","null"]; def str: ["string"]; def strn: ["string","null"];
      def objn: ["object","null"]; def booln: ["boolean","null"];
      if type != "object" then "row is not a JSON object" else (.) as $row |
      [ need("schema_version"; num), need("run_id"; str), need("batch"; str), need("arm"; str),
        need("task_id"; str), need("task_type"; str), need("trial"; num), need("source_commit"; str),
        need("suite_manifest_sha256"; strn), need("suite_version"; ["number","string","null"]),
        need("host_fingerprint"; strn), need("image_digest"; strn), need("agy_opt_in"; ["boolean"]),
        need("started"; str), need("finished"; strn), need("phases"; ["array"]),
        need("voices_run"; objn), need("hidden_tests"; objn), need("hidden_test_pass_rate"; numn),
        need("defects_seeded"; numn), need("defects_caught"; numn), need("defect_catch_rate"; numn),
        need("flags"; numn), need("false_positives"; numn), need("verdict"; strn),
        need("verdict_accuracy"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_review"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_audit"; booln),
        need("regressions"; numn), need("diff_lines"; numn), need("files_changed"; numn),
        need("cost_usd"; num), need("wall_clock_ms"; num), need("tokens_in"; num), need("tokens_out"; num),
        need("stalls"; num), need("attempts"; num), need("retry_reason"; strn),
        need("degraded"; ["boolean"]), need("degraded_reason"; strn), need("status"; str),
        need("snapshots"; ["object"]), need("contaminated"; objn), need("zone_violations"; ["object"]) ][0]
      // (if (["feature-build","bug-fix","refactor","review-catch"] | index($row.task_type)) == null
           then "task_type \(.task_type) is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" else empty end)
      // (if ($st | index($row.status)) == null then "status \(.status) is not one of \($st | join("|"))" else empty end)
      // (if (.zone_violations.dot_claude_writes | type) != "array" then "zone_violations.dot_claude_writes is not an array" else empty end)
      // (if (.degraded == true) and (.degraded_reason == null) then "degraded without degraded_reason" else empty end)
      // (if .verdict != null and ((["APPROVED","CHANGES_REQUIRED"] | index($row.verdict)) == null)
           then "verdict \(.verdict) is not APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED" else empty end)
      // ([.snapshots | to_entries[] | select((.value | type) != "string" and (.value | type) != "null")
           | "snapshots.\(.key) is not a string"][0])
      // ([.phases | to_entries[] | .key as $i | .value as $p
           | ( if ($p | type) != "object" then "phases[\($i)] is not an object" else
               ([ ($p | need("name"; str)), ($p | need("session_id"; strn)), ($p | need("model_requested"; str)),
                  ($p | need("models_used"; ["object"])), ($p | need("effort_requested"; strn)),
                  ($p | need("effort_effective"; strn)), ($p | need("tokens_in"; num)), ($p | need("tokens_out"; num)),
                  ($p | need("cache_read_tokens"; num)), ($p | need("cache_creation_tokens"; num)),
                  ($p | need("cost_usd"; num)), ($p | need("duration_ms"; num)), ($p | need("num_turns"; num)),
                  ($p | need("exit"; num)), ($p | need("refusal_fallbacks"; ["array"])) ][0]
                | if . then "phases[\($i)]: \(.)" else empty end) end )][0])
      // (if $ungraded then empty
          elif (["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","contaminated"] | index($row.status)) == null then empty
          elif .task_type == "review-catch" then
            (if (.defect_catch_rate | type) != "number" then "graded review-catch row has no defect_catch_rate (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
          else
            (if (.hidden_tests | type) != "object" or (.hidden_test_pass_rate | type) != "number"
               then "graded build row has no hidden_tests (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
          end)
      // empty
      end' 2>/dev/null <<<"$line")" || err="line is not valid JSON"
    if [[ -n "$err" ]]; then
      echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE:$n: $err" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  done < "$VALIDATE"
  echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE: $n rows valid"
  exit 0
fi

# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"
[[ -f "$PIPE" ]] || usage "no meta/pipeline.json under $RUN_DIR"
jq -e 'type == "object"' "$PIPE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
[[ "$ATTEMPTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || usage "--attempts must be an integer"
if [[ -n "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" ]] && ! jq -e --arg s "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" 'index($s) != null' <<<"$STATUSES" >/dev/null; then
  usage "--status must be one of $(jq -r 'join("|")' <<<"$STATUSES")"
fi
[[ -n "$GRADE" ]] || { [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/grade.json" ]] && GRADE="$RUN_DIR/grade.json"; } || true
GRADE_JSON=null
if [[ -n "$GRADE" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$GRADE" ]] || usage "grade file not found: $GRADE"
  GRADE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$GRADE")" || usage "grade file does not parse: $GRADE"
fi
MAN_JSON='{}'
if [[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || usage "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
  MAN_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$MANIFEST")" || usage "manifest does not parse: $MANIFEST"
fi
TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || usage "task yaml does not parse"
PIPE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$PIPE")"
RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")"

# arm: manifest arm_map > meta/arm > pipeline.json; never sandbox/
META_ARM=""
[[ -f "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" ]] && META_ARM="$(sed -n '1p' "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
MAN_ARM="$(jq -r --arg r "$RUN_ID" '.arm_map[$r] // empty' <<<"$MAN_JSON")"
if [[ -n "$MAN_ARM" && -n "$META_ARM" && "$MAN_ARM" != "$META_ARM" ]]; then
  usage "arm mismatch for $RUN_ID: manifest arm_map says $MAN_ARM, meta/arm says $META_ARM"
fi
ARM="${MAN_ARM:-${META_ARM:-$(jq -r '.arm // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")}}"
[[ -n "$ARM" ]] || usage "no arm for $RUN_ID (manifest arm_map, meta/arm, pipeline.json)"

# MODELINV rows as an array with their 1-based line numbers
MINV='[]'
if [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
  MINV="$(awk '{print NR "\t" $0}' "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" \
          | jq -R -n -c '[inputs | split("\t") | {line: (.[0] | tonumber), row: (.[1:] | join("\t") | fromjson? // null)}
                         | select(.row != null)]')"
fi

envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → JSON or null
  local f="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
  if [[ -f "$f" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '.' "$f"; else echo null; fi
}
ENV_REVIEW="$(envelope review)"
ENV_AUDIT="$(envelope audit)"

# Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/ from every transcript
DOT_WRITES='[]'
shopt -s nullglob
ev_files=("$RUN_DIR"/transcripts/events-*.jsonl)
shopt -u nullglob
if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  DOT_WRITES="$(for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use"
                 and (.name == "Write" or .name == "Edit" or .name == "MultiEdit" or .name == "NotebookEdit"))
        | {phase: $ph, tool: .name, path: (.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
        | select(.path | test("(^|/)\\.claude/"))' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
    done | jq -s -c '.')"
fi

ROW="$(jq -n -c \
  --argjson p "$PIPE_JSON" --argjson task "$TASK_JSON" --argjson g "$GRADE_JSON" --argjson m "$MAN_JSON" \
  --argjson minv "$MINV" --argjson er "$ENV_REVIEW" --argjson ea "$ENV_AUDIT" --argjson dot "$DOT_WRITES" \
  --arg arm "$ARM" --arg status_override "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" --argjson attempts "$ATTEMPTS" \
  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
  def ms(ts): if ts == null then null else (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) end;
  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
      {planned: (e.verdict_quality.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
       completed: (e.verdict_quality.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
       quality: (e.verdict_quality.status // e.status // null),
       companion_planned: e.metadata.companion_voice.planned} end;
  ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
  | [ $ran[] as $ph
      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
      | $ph + {
          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],
          model_mismatches: [ ($ph.models_used // {}) | keys[] | select((. | norm_model) != ($ph.model_requested | norm_model)) ]
        } ] as $phases
  | ( [ $phases[] | .label as $l
        | .model_requested as $req
        | ( .model_mismatches[] | "\($l): model \(.) used, \($req) requested" ),
          ( if (.refusal_fallbacks | length) > 0 then "\($l): refusal fallback" else empty end ),
          ( .effort_mismatches[] | "\($l): MODELINV \(.)" ) ]
      + [ (["review", $er], ["audit", $ea]) | (.) as [$gate, $e] | select($e != null)
          | voices($e) as $v
          | ( if $v.quality == "DEGRADED" then "\($gate) envelope verdict_quality DEGRADED" else empty end ),
            ( if ($v.planned != null and $v.completed != null and $v.completed < $v.planned)
                then "\($gate) envelope \($v.completed) of \($v.planned) voices completed" else empty end ) ]
    ) as $why
  | ($p.status // "infrastructure_error" | if . == "running" then "interrupted" else . end) as $pst
  | (if $status_override != "" then $status_override
     elif ($g != null and ($g.contaminated // null) != null) then "contaminated"
     else $pst end) as $status
  | ($g.hidden_tests // null | if type == "object" then {passed: (.passed // 0), total: (.total // 0)} else null end) as $ht
  | ($g.recall // null) as $rc
  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_seeded // $rc.seeded // $rc.total // null) end) as $seeded
  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_caught // $rc.caught // null) end) as $caught
  | {
      schema_version: 1,
      run_id: ($p.run_id // ""),
      batch: ($m.batch // $m.batch_name // "unbatched"),
      arm: $arm,
      task_id: ($task.id // $p.task_id // ""),
      task_type: ($task.type // $p.task_type // ""),
      trial: ($p.trial // 0),
      source_commit: ($p.source_commit // $m.source_commit // ""),
      suite_manifest_sha256: ($m.suite_manifest_sha256 // null),
      suite_version: ($m.suite_version // $p.suite_version // $task.suite_version // null),
      host_fingerprint: ($m.fingerprint // $p.fingerprint // null),
      image_digest: ($m.image_digest // $p.image_digest // null),
      executor_mode: ($m.executor_mode // $p.executor_mode // null),
      agy_opt_in: ($m.agy_opt_in // false),
      started: ($p.started // ""),
      finished: ($p.finished // null),
      phases: [ $phases[] | {name, label, session_id, model_requested, models_used, effort_requested, effort_effective,
                             tokens_in: (.tokens_in // 0), tokens_out: (.tokens_out // 0),
                             cache_read_tokens: (.cache_read_tokens // 0), cache_creation_tokens: (.cache_creation_tokens // 0),
                             cost_usd: (.cost_usd // 0), voice_cost_usd, ledger_cost_usd: (.ledger_cost_usd // 0),
                             duration_ms: (.duration_ms // 0), num_turns: (.num_turns // 0), exit: (.exit // -1),
                             timed_out: (.timed_out // false), refusal_fallbacks: (.refusal_fallbacks // []),
                             snapshot: (.snapshot // null), verdict: (.verdict // null)} ],
      voices_run: (if $er == null and $ea == null then null else {review: voices($er), audit: voices($ea)} end),
      hidden_tests: $ht,
      hidden_test_pass_rate: (if $ht == null or $ht.total == 0 then null else ($ht.passed / $ht.total) end),
      defects_seeded: $seeded,
      defects_caught: $caught,
      defect_catch_rate: (if $rc == null then null
                          else ($rc.recall // $rc.rate // $rc.defect_catch_rate
                                // (if $seeded != null and $seeded > 0 and $caught != null then $caught / $seeded else null end)) end),
      flags: ($rc.flags // $g.flags // null),
      false_positives: ($g.false_positives // null | if type == "array" then length else . end),
      verdict: ($g.verdict | if type == "object" then .value else . end // null),
      verdict_accuracy: ($g.verdict_accuracy | if type == "object" then .value else . end),
      verdict_accuracy_review: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_review | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_review
                                else $g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate.review end),
      verdict_accuracy_audit: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_audit | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_audit
                               else $g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate.audit end),
      regressions: ($g.regressions // null | if type == "object" then ((.newly_failing // []) | length)
                                            elif type == "array" then length else . end),
      diff_lines: ($g.diff_lines // null),
      files_changed: ($g.files_changed // null),
      cost_usd: ([$phases[] | (.cost_usd // 0) + (.ledger_cost_usd // 0)] | add // 0),
      wall_clock_ms: (if $p.started != null and $p.finished != null then (ms($p.finished) - ms($p.started))
                      else ([$phases[] | .wall_ms // .duration_ms // 0] | add // 0) end),
      tokens_in: ([$phases[] | .tokens_in // 0] | add // 0),
      tokens_out: ([$phases[] | .tokens_out // 0] | add // 0),
      stalls: ([$phases[] | select(.timed_out == true)] | length),
      attempts: $attempts,
      retry_reason: (if $retry_reason == "" then null else $retry_reason end),
      degraded: (($why | length) > 0),
      degraded_reason: (if ($why | length) == 0 then null else ($why | join("; ")) end),
      status: $status,
      cap_phase: ($p.cap_phase // null),
      snapshots: {implement: ($p.snapshots.implement // null), fix1: ($p.snapshots.fix1 // null), fix2: ($p.snapshots.fix2 // null)},
      contaminated: ($g.contaminated // null | if type == "object" then {phase: (.phase // null), pattern: (.pattern // null)} else null end),
      zone_violations: {dot_claude_writes: $dot}
    }')"

if [[ -n "$OUT" ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    { flock -x 9; printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"; } 9>>"$OUT.lock"
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"
  fi
else
  printf '%s\n' "$ROW"
fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
5	#
6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
11	#
12	# Rules:
13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
33	#                              are not frontmatter)
34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
37	#                              "no mount"
38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
42	#
43	# Usage:
44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
46	#
47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
50	#
51	# Exit codes:
52	#   0  every rule OK
53	#   1  any rule FAIL
54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
55	#
56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
58	# =============================================================================
59	set -euo pipefail
60	export LC_ALL=C
61	
62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
64	
65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
68	  case "$1" in
69	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
70	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
71	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
72	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
73	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
74	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
75	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
76	  esac
77	done
78	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
79	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
80	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
81	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
82	
83	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
84	EVID=""
85	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
86	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
87	  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
88	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
89	  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
90	}
91	
92	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
93	  local type kind
94	  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
95	  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi
96	  jq -r -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --arg kind "$kind" \
97	    --argjson tg "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles // {}' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" '
98	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
99	    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
100	    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
101	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
102	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
103	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
104	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
105	    | .out | join(",")'
106	}
107	
108	rule_no_dot_claude() {
109	  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi
110	  EVID="sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md"
111	}
112	rule_no_system_prompt() {
113	  local f n=0 hit=""
114	  while IFS= read -r f; do
115	    n=$((n + 1))
116	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
117	  done < <(argv_files)
118	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
119	  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }
120	  EVID="no --append-system-prompt-file in $n argv"
121	}
122	rule_no_audit_rows() {
123	  [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl" ]] && { EVID="sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl exists"; return 1; }
124	  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"
125	}
126	rule_all_phases_present() {
127	  local want got st
128	  want="$(expected_labels)"
129	  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
130	  st="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
131	  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then EVID="phases $got"; return 0; fi
132	  case "$st" in
133	    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)
134	      if [[ -n "$got" && ",$want," == ",$got,"* ]]; then EVID="phases $got (run stopped: $st; set $want)"; return 0; fi ;;
135	  esac
136	  EVID="phases ${got:-none}, want $want (status $st)"; return 1
137	}
138	rule_no_plan_phase() {
139	  local n; n="$(jq '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN")] | length' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
140	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n PLAN record(s)"; return 1; }
141	  EVID="no PLAN record"
142	}
143	rule_one_voice_planned() {
144	  local g f v bad="" ev=""
145	  for g in review audit; do
146	    f="$(envelope "$g")"
147	    if [[ -z "$f" ]]; then bad="$bad $g:missing"; continue; fi
148	    v="$(jq -r 'if (.metadata.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .metadata.companion_voice.planned
149	                elif (.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .companion_voice.planned else "absent" end | tostring' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
150	    ev="$ev $g:planned=$v"
151	    [[ "$v" == false ]] || bad="$bad $g:planned=$v"
152	  done
153	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="companion_voice${bad}"; return 1; }
154	  EVID="companion_voice${ev}"
155	}
156	rule_no_gate_phases() {
157	  local got; got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" or .name == "AUDIT" or .name == "FIX") | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
158	  [[ -z "$got" ]] || { EVID="gate records $got"; return 1; }
159	  EVID="no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record"
160	}
161	rule_enforce_env_false() {
162	  local f n=0 bad=""
163	  while IFS= read -r f; do
164	    n=$((n + 1))
165	    [[ "$(jq -r '.env.LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE // "unset"' "$f")" == false ]] || bad="$bad $(basename "$f" .argv.json)"
166	  done < <(argv_files)
167	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
168	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE not false in$bad"; return 1; }
169	  EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false in $n/$n phase env"
170	}
171	rule_no_flatline_rows() {
172	  local n=0
173	  if [[ -f "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
174	    n="$(jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
175	           | (.payload.calling_primitive // .calling_primitive // .agent // "") | select(test("^flatline"))] | length' \
176	         "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl")"
177	  fi
178	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n flatline MODELINV row(s)"; return 1; }
179	  [[ -f "$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md" ]] || { EVID="no flatline rows but no sandbox sprint.md"; return 1; }
180	  EVID="no flatline MODELINV rows; sprint.md present"
181	}
182	rule_implementer_single_session() {
183	  local ids n sid f bad=""
184	  ids="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true and (.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX")) | .session_id]' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
185	  n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$ids")"
186	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no implementer record"; return 1; }
187	  [[ "$(jq '[.[] | select(. == null)] | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="an implementer record has no session_id"; return 1; }
188	  [[ "$(jq 'unique | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 1 ]] || { EVID="implementer session ids $(jq -r 'unique | join(",")' <<<"$ids")"; return 1; }
189	  sid="$(jq -r '.[0]' <<<"$ids")"
190	  while IFS= read -r f; do
191	    case "$(jq -r '.name' "$f")" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) ;; *) continue ;; esac
192	    jq -e '.resume == null' "$f" >/dev/null && continue
193	    jq -e --arg s "$sid" '.resume == $s and ((.argv | index("--resume")) as $i | $i != null and .argv[$i + 1] == $s)' "$f" >/dev/null \
194	      || bad="$bad $(jq -r '.label' "$f")"
195	  done < <(argv_files)
196	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="continuation argv does not resume $sid:$bad"; return 1; }
197	  EVID="one session $sid across $n implementer record(s)"
198	}
199	rule_gates_separate_sessions() {
200	  local r a impl
201	  r="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
202	  a="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "AUDIT" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
203	  impl="$(jq -c '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX") | .session_id | select(. != null)] | unique' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
204	  [[ "$r" != null && "$a" != null ]] || { EVID="gate session ids review=$r audit=$a"; return 1; }
205	  [[ "$r" != "$a" ]] || { EVID="REVIEW and AUDIT share session $r"; return 1; }
206	  if jq -e --arg r "$r" --arg a "$a" 'index($r) != null or index($a) != null' <<<"$impl" >/dev/null; then
207	    EVID="a gate shares an implementer session"; return 1
208	  fi
209	  EVID="review $r, audit $a, implementer $(jq -r 'join(",")' <<<"$impl")"
210	}
211	rule_effort_flag_medium() {
212	  local f n=0 ok=0
213	  while IFS= read -r f; do
214	    n=$((n + 1))
215	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | (index("--effort")) as $i | $i != null and .[$i + 1] == "medium"' "$f" >/dev/null && ok=$((ok + 1))
216	  done < <(argv_files)
217	  [[ $n -gt 0 && $ok -eq $n ]] || { EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"; return 1; }
218	  EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"
219	}
220	rule_skill_effort_stripped() {
221	  local f n=0 hit=0
222	  for f in "$R"/sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
223	    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
224	    n=$((n + 1))
225	    # the YAML frontmatter only (first line `---` to the next `---`); a body line may say effort:
226	    awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" {exit} NR > 1 && $0 == "---" {exit} NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {hit = 1; exit} END {exit !hit}' "$f" \
227	      && hit=$((hit + 1))
228	  done
229	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no sandbox SKILL.md"; return 1; }
230	  [[ $hit -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$hit/$n SKILL.md still carry effort:"; return 1; }
231	  EVID="skill effort lines stripped $n/$n"
232	}
233	rule_integrity_clean() {
234	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
235	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
236	    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
237	    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
238	  fi
239	  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
240	  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
241	  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
242	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
243	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
244	import hashlib, json, os, sys
245	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
246	def sha(p):
247	    h = hashlib.sha256()
248	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
249	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
250	            h.update(b)
251	    return h.hexdigest()
252	files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
253	bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
254	for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
255	    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
256	    if not os.path.isfile(p):
257	        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
258	    elif sha(p) != want:
259	        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
260	print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
261	  local n bad missing filesha first
262	  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
263	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
264	  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
265	  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
266	  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
267	  return 0
268	}
269	rule_applicability_refused() {
270	  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
271	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
272	    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
273	    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
274	    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch
275	    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
276	         <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
277	      EVID="applicable: $t in task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") (no refusal needed)"; return 0
278	    fi
279	    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
280	  fi
281	  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
282	  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
283	  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
284	  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
285	       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
286	    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
287	  fi
288	  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
289	}
290	
291	# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
292	check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
293	  R="$1"
294	  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
295	  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
296	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
297	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
298	  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
299	  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
300	  ARM="$arm"
301	  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
302	  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
303	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
304	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
305	    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
306	    return 0
307	  fi
308	  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
309	    rules="applicability_refused"
310	  else
311	    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
312	    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
313	    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
314	  fi
315	  while IFS= read -r rule; do
316	    [[ -n "$rule" ]] || continue
317	    total=$((total + 1)); EVID=""
318	    if declare -F "rule_$rule" >/dev/null; then
319	      if "rule_$rule"; then ok=true; else ok=false; fi
320	    else
321	      ok=false; EVID="unknown rule id"
322	    fi
323	    [[ "$ok" == true ]] || fails=$((fails + 1))
324	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
325	      results="$(jq -c --arg r "$rule" --argjson ok "$ok" --arg e "$EVID" '. + [{rule: $r, ok: $ok, evidence: $e}]' <<<"$results")"
326	    else
327	      printf 'arm %s: %s %s %s\n' "$arm" "$rule" "$([[ "$ok" == true ]] && echo OK || echo FAIL)" "$EVID"
328	    fi
329	  done <<<"$rules"
330	  if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
331	    jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson rules "$results" --argjson ok "$([[ $fails -eq 0 ]] && echo true || echo false)" \
332	      '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: $ok, rules: $rules}'
333	  elif [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]; then
334	    printf 'arm %s: OK\n' "$arm"
335	  else
336	    printf 'arm %s: FAIL (%d of %d rules)\n' "$arm" "$fails" "$total"
337	  fi
338	  [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]
339	}
340	
341	if [[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]]; then
342	  [[ -d "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "run dir not found: $RUN_DIR"
343	  rc=0; check_run "$RUN_DIR" || rc=$?
344	  exit "$rc"
345	fi
346	
347	[[ -d "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "batch dir not found: $BATCH_DIR"
348	runs=0 failed=0
349	while IFS= read -r d; do
350	  runs=$((runs + 1))
351	  rc=0; check_run "$d" || rc=$?
352	  [[ $rc -eq 2 ]] && exit 2
353	  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || failed=$((failed + 1))
354	done < <(find "$BATCH_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4 -type d -name meta \
355	           \( -exec test -f '{}/pipeline.json' \; -o -exec test -f '{}/refused.json' \; \) -print \
356	         | sed 's|/meta$||' | LC_ALL=C sort)
357	[[ $runs -gt 0 ]] || usage "no run directories under $BATCH_DIR"
358	[[ "$JSON" == true ]] || printf 'took-effect: %d runs, %d failed\n' "$runs" "$failed"
359	[[ $failed -eq 0 ]]
360

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
#
# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
#
# Rules:
#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
#                              each other and from every implementer session id
#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
#                              are not frontmatter)
#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
#                              "no mount"
#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
#
# Usage:
#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
#
# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  every rule OK
#   1  any rule FAIL
#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
#
# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
# "Validate grader trust boundary").

RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
  esac
done
[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"

# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
EVID=""
argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
}

expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
  local type kind
  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi
  jq -r -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --arg kind "$kind" \
    --argjson tg "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles // {}' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" '
    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
    | .out | join(",")'
}

rule_no_dot_claude() {
  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi
  EVID="sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md"
}
rule_no_system_prompt() {
  local f n=0 hit=""
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
  done < <(argv_files)
  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }
  EVID="no --append-system-prompt-file in $n argv"
}
rule_no_audit_rows() {
  [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl" ]] && { EVID="sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl exists"; return 1; }
  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"
}
rule_all_phases_present() {
  local want got st
  want="$(expected_labels)"
  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  st="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then EVID="phases $got"; return 0; fi
  case "$st" in
    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)
      if [[ -n "$got" && ",$want," == ",$got,"* ]]; then EVID="phases $got (run stopped: $st; set $want)"; return 0; fi ;;
  esac
  EVID="phases ${got:-none}, want $want (status $st)"; return 1
}
rule_no_plan_phase() {
  local n; n="$(jq '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN")] | length' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n PLAN record(s)"; return 1; }
  EVID="no PLAN record"
}
rule_one_voice_planned() {
  local g f v bad="" ev=""
  for g in review audit; do
    f="$(envelope "$g")"
    if [[ -z "$f" ]]; then bad="$bad $g:missing"; continue; fi
    v="$(jq -r 'if (.metadata.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .metadata.companion_voice.planned
                elif (.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .companion_voice.planned else "absent" end | tostring' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
    ev="$ev $g:planned=$v"
    [[ "$v" == false ]] || bad="$bad $g:planned=$v"
  done
  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="companion_voice${bad}"; return 1; }
  EVID="companion_voice${ev}"
}
rule_no_gate_phases() {
  local got; got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" or .name == "AUDIT" or .name == "FIX") | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  [[ -z "$got" ]] || { EVID="gate records $got"; return 1; }
  EVID="no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record"
}
rule_enforce_env_false() {
  local f n=0 bad=""
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    [[ "$(jq -r '.env.LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE // "unset"' "$f")" == false ]] || bad="$bad $(basename "$f" .argv.json)"
  done < <(argv_files)
  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE not false in$bad"; return 1; }
  EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false in $n/$n phase env"
}
rule_no_flatline_rows() {
  local n=0
  if [[ -f "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
    n="$(jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
           | (.payload.calling_primitive // .calling_primitive // .agent // "") | select(test("^flatline"))] | length' \
         "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl")"
  fi
  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n flatline MODELINV row(s)"; return 1; }
  [[ -f "$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md" ]] || { EVID="no flatline rows but no sandbox sprint.md"; return 1; }
  EVID="no flatline MODELINV rows; sprint.md present"
}
rule_implementer_single_session() {
  local ids n sid f bad=""
  ids="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true and (.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX")) | .session_id]' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$ids")"
  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no implementer record"; return 1; }
  [[ "$(jq '[.[] | select(. == null)] | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="an implementer record has no session_id"; return 1; }
  [[ "$(jq 'unique | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 1 ]] || { EVID="implementer session ids $(jq -r 'unique | join(",")' <<<"$ids")"; return 1; }
  sid="$(jq -r '.[0]' <<<"$ids")"
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    case "$(jq -r '.name' "$f")" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) ;; *) continue ;; esac
    jq -e '.resume == null' "$f" >/dev/null && continue
    jq -e --arg s "$sid" '.resume == $s and ((.argv | index("--resume")) as $i | $i != null and .argv[$i + 1] == $s)' "$f" >/dev/null \
      || bad="$bad $(jq -r '.label' "$f")"
  done < <(argv_files)
  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="continuation argv does not resume $sid:$bad"; return 1; }
  EVID="one session $sid across $n implementer record(s)"
}
rule_gates_separate_sessions() {
  local r a impl
  r="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  a="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "AUDIT" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  impl="$(jq -c '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX") | .session_id | select(. != null)] | unique' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  [[ "$r" != null && "$a" != null ]] || { EVID="gate session ids review=$r audit=$a"; return 1; }
  [[ "$r" != "$a" ]] || { EVID="REVIEW and AUDIT share session $r"; return 1; }
  if jq -e --arg r "$r" --arg a "$a" 'index($r) != null or index($a) != null' <<<"$impl" >/dev/null; then
    EVID="a gate shares an implementer session"; return 1
  fi
  EVID="review $r, audit $a, implementer $(jq -r 'join(",")' <<<"$impl")"
}
rule_effort_flag_medium() {
  local f n=0 ok=0
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    jq -e '(.argv // []) | (index("--effort")) as $i | $i != null and .[$i + 1] == "medium"' "$f" >/dev/null && ok=$((ok + 1))
  done < <(argv_files)
  [[ $n -gt 0 && $ok -eq $n ]] || { EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"; return 1; }
  EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"
}
rule_skill_effort_stripped() {
  local f n=0 hit=0
  for f in "$R"/sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
    n=$((n + 1))
    # the YAML frontmatter only (first line `---` to the next `---`); a body line may say effort:
    awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" {exit} NR > 1 && $0 == "---" {exit} NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {hit = 1; exit} END {exit !hit}' "$f" \
      && hit=$((hit + 1))
  done
  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no sandbox SKILL.md"; return 1; }
  [[ $hit -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$hit/$n SKILL.md still carry effort:"; return 1; }
  EVID="skill effort lines stripped $n/$n"
}
rule_integrity_clean() {
  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
  fi
  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
  out="$(python3 -I -c '
import hashlib, json, os, sys
root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
def sha(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()
files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
    if not os.path.isfile(p):
        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
    elif sha(p) != want:
        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
  local n bad missing filesha first
  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
  return 0
}
rule_applicability_refused() {
  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch
    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
         <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
      EVID="applicable: $t in task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") (no refusal needed)"; return 0
    fi
    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
  fi
  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
  fi
  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
}

# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
  R="$1"
  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
  ARM="$arm"
  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
    return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
    rules="applicability_refused"
  else
    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
  fi
  while IFS= read -r rule; do
    [[ -n "$rule" ]] || continue
    total=$((total + 1)); EVID=""
    if declare -F "rule_$rule" >/dev/null; then
      if "rule_$rule"; then ok=true; else ok=false; fi
    else
      ok=false; EVID="unknown rule id"
    fi
    [[ "$ok" == true ]] || fails=$((fails + 1))
    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
      results="$(jq -c --arg r "$rule" --argjson ok "$ok" --arg e "$EVID" '. + [{rule: $r, ok: $ok, evidence: $e}]' <<<"$results")"
    else
      printf 'arm %s: %s %s %s\n' "$arm" "$rule" "$([[ "$ok" == true ]] && echo OK || echo FAIL)" "$EVID"
    fi
  done <<<"$rules"
  if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
    jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson rules "$results" --argjson ok "$([[ $fails -eq 0 ]] && echo true || echo false)" \
      '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: $ok, rules: $rules}'
  elif [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]; then
    printf 'arm %s: OK\n' "$arm"
  else
    printf 'arm %s: FAIL (%d of %d rules)\n' "$arm" "$fails" "$total"
  fi
  [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]
}

if [[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]]; then
  [[ -d "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "run dir not found: $RUN_DIR"
  rc=0; check_run "$RUN_DIR" || rc=$?
  exit "$rc"
fi

[[ -d "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "batch dir not found: $BATCH_DIR"
runs=0 failed=0
while IFS= read -r d; do
  runs=$((runs + 1))
  rc=0; check_run "$d" || rc=$?
  [[ $rc -eq 2 ]] && exit 2
  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || failed=$((failed + 1))
done < <(find "$BATCH_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4 -type d -name meta \
           \( -exec test -f '{}/pipeline.json' \; -o -exec test -f '{}/refused.json' \; \) -print \
         | sed 's|/meta$||' | LC_ALL=C sort)
[[ $runs -gt 0 ]] || usage "no run directories under $BATCH_DIR"
[[ "$JSON" == true ]] || printf 'took-effect: %d runs, %d failed\n' "$runs" "$failed"
[[ $failed -eq 0 ]]

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
     4	#
     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
     7	#
     8	# Usage:
     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
    11	#
    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    21	#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
    22	#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
    23	#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
    26	#
    27	# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
    28	#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
    29	#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
    30	#
    31	# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
    32	# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
    33	# =============================================================================
    34	set -euo pipefail
    35	export LC_ALL=C
    36	
    37	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    38	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    39	SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
    40	LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
    41	RUNS=()
    42	
    43	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    44	die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    45	num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }
    46	
    47	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    48	  case "$1" in
    49	    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    50	    --runs)
    51	      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
    52	      shift
    53	      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    54	    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    55	    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    56	    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
    58	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    59	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    60	  esac
    61	done
    62	[[ "$SINCE" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?)?$ ]] \
    63	  || die "--since must be an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z)"
    64	command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: python3"
    65	
    66	SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    67	yq_num() {  # yq_num <expr> <file> — a number or empty
    68	  local v
    69	  [[ -f "$2" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
    70	  v="$(yq -r "$1 // \"\"" "$2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    71	  num_ok "$v" && printf '%s' "$v"
    72	  return 0
    73	}
    74	if [[ -z "$CAP" ]]; then
    75	  CAP="$(yq_num '.evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml")"
    76	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP="$(yq_num '.caps.cycle_usd' "$SUITE")"
    77	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP=1500
    78	fi
    79	if [[ -z "$RESERVE" ]]; then
    80	  RESERVE="$(yq_num '.caps.reserve_usd' "$SUITE")"
    81	  [[ -n "$RESERVE" ]] || RESERVE=250
    82	fi
    83	num_ok "$CAP" || die "--cap must be a non-negative number"
    84	num_ok "$RESERVE" || die "--reserve must be a non-negative number"
    85	
    86	# Explicit files must be readable; defaults are optional (absent = zero).
    87	if [[ ${#RUNS[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    88	  [[ -e "$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl" ]] && RUNS+=("$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl")
    89	  for f in "$REPO_ROOT"/evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl; do [[ -e "$f" ]] && RUNS+=("$f"); done
    90	fi
    91	EXPLICIT_LEDGER=true
    92	if [[ -z "$LEDGER" ]]; then
    93	  EXPLICIT_LEDGER=false
    94	  LEDGER="$REPO_ROOT/.run/cost-ledger.jsonl"
    95	fi
    96	for f in ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"}; do
    97	  [[ -f "$f" && -r "$f" ]] || { echo "spend: run-row file unreadable: $f" >&2; exit 1; }
    98	done
    99	if [[ -e "$LEDGER" || "$EXPLICIT_LEDGER" == "true" ]]; then
   100	  [[ -f "$LEDGER" && -r "$LEDGER" ]] || { echo "spend: ledger unreadable: $LEDGER" >&2; exit 1; }
   101	else
   102	  LEDGER=""
   103	fi
   104	
   105	python3 -I - "$SINCE" "$CAP" "$RESERVE" "$JSON" "$LEDGER" ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"} <<'PY'
   106	import json, sys
   107	from datetime import datetime, timezone
   108	
   109	since_s, cap, reserve, as_json, ledger = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] == "true", sys.argv[5]
   110	runs_files = sys.argv[6:]
   111	
   112	def ts(s):
   113	    s = s.strip()
   114	    if len(s) == 10:
   115	        s += "T00:00:00Z"
   116	    d = datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
   117	    return d if d.tzinfo else d.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
   118	
   119	since = ts(since_s)
   120	skipped = 0
   121	runs_usd, runs_rows, dedup = 0.0, 0, 0
   122	seen = set()
   123	for f in runs_files:
   124	    for line in open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
   125	        if not line.strip():
   126	            continue
   127	        try:
   128	            r = json.loads(line)
   129	            c = float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0)
   130	        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
   131	            skipped += 1
   132	            continue
   133	        rid = r.get("run_id")
   134	        key = rid if isinstance(rid, str) and rid else None
   135	        if key is not None and key in seen:
   136	            dedup += 1
   137	            continue
   138	        if key is not None:
   139	            seen.add(key)
   140	        runs_usd += c
   141	        runs_rows += 1
   142	
   143	ledger_usd, ledger_rows = 0.0, 0
   144	if ledger:
   145	    for line in open(ledger, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
   146	        if not line.strip():
   147	            continue
   148	        try:
   149	            r = json.loads(line)
   150	            if ts(str(r["ts"])) < since:
   151	                continue
   152	            ledger_usd += float(r.get("cost_micro_usd") or 0) / 1e6
   153	            ledger_rows += 1
   154	        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
   155	            skipped += 1
   156	
   157	total = runs_usd + ledger_usd
   158	headroom = cap - total
   159	if skipped:
   160	    print(f"spend: skipped {skipped} malformed line(s)", file=sys.stderr)
   161	def n(x):
   162	    x = round(x, 4)
   163	    return int(x) if x == int(x) else x
   164	if as_json:
   165	    print(json.dumps({
   166	        "total_usd": n(total), "runs_usd": n(runs_usd), "ledger_usd": n(ledger_usd),
   167	        "since": since_s, "cap_usd": n(cap), "headroom_usd": n(headroom), "reserve_usd": n(reserve),
   168	        "runs_files": runs_files, "ledger_file": ledger or None, "runs_rows": runs_rows,
   169	        "runs_rows_deduped": dedup, "ledger_rows": ledger_rows, "skipped_lines": skipped}, sort_keys=True))
   170	else:
   171	    def money(x): return f"{x:,.2f}"
   172	    def whole(x): return f"{x:,.0f}" if x == int(x) else f"{x:,.2f}"
   173	    print(f"cycle spend USD {money(total)} (runs {money(runs_usd)} + ledger {money(ledger_usd)} since {since_s}); "
   174	          f"cap {whole(cap)}; headroom {money(headroom)}; reserve {whole(reserve)}")
   175	PY

3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)

5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
6	#
7	# Usage:
8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
9	#
10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
16	#
17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?}, post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
21	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
22	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
23	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
24	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
25	#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;

     4	#
     5	# Writes or verifies <root>/MANIFEST.sha256, the suite's frozen identity: one
     6	# "<sha256>  <relpath>" line per file under <root>/tasks/ (and <root>/smoke/
     7	# with --smoke), relpath relative to the root, LC_ALL=C sorted, sha256 (Python
     8	# hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code, eval.yml trust boundary).
     9	# validate-suite.sh runs first; an invalid suite is never frozen or accepted.
    10	#
    11	# Usage:
    12	#   freeze.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--check] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
    13	#
    14	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
    15	#   --smoke           cover smoke/ too (passed to the validator as well)
    16	#   --check           recompute and compare with MANIFEST.sha256; write nothing
    17	#   --allow-partial   passed to validate-suite.sh (fewer than four tasks per type)
    18	#   --suite-file F    passed to validate-suite.sh
    19	#
    20	# Output: `freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (N files, sha256 <digest of the manifest>)`
    21	# or `freeze: OK — N files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 …)`; on drift every
    22	# changed / added / removed path on its own line.
    23	#
    24	# Exit: 0 written / matches; 1 drift, missing manifest under --check, or the
    25	#       validator found violations; 2 usage.
    26	# Tested by evals/tests/freeze.bats.
    27	# =============================================================================
    28	set -euo pipefail
    29	export LC_ALL=C
    30	
    31	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    32	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    33	
    34	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    35	CHECK=false SMOKE=false
    36	VARGS=()
    37	
    38	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,26p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    39	die() { echo "freeze: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    40	
    41	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    42	  case "$1" in
    43	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    44	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; VARGS+=(--smoke); shift ;;
    45	    --check) CHECK=true; shift ;;
    46	    --allow-partial) VARGS+=(--allow-partial); shift ;;
    47	    --suite-file) [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] || die "--suite-file needs a path"; VARGS+=(--suite-file "$2"); shift 2 ;;
    48	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    49	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    50	  esac
    51	done
    52	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    53	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    54	MANIFEST="$ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256"
    55	
    56	vrc=0
    57	"$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-suite.sh" --root "$ROOT" ${VARGS[@]+"${VARGS[@]}"} || vrc=$?
    58	if [[ $vrc -eq 1 ]]; then echo "freeze: refused — the suite does not validate" >&2; exit 1; fi
    59	[[ $vrc -eq 0 ]] || die "validate-suite.sh failed (exit $vrc)"
    60	
    61	# compute_manifest <out> — the manifest body for the current tree.
    62	compute_manifest() {
    63	  local out="$1" list dirs=(tasks)
    64	  [[ "$SMOKE" == "true" ]] && dirs+=(smoke)
    65	  list="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze-list.XXXXXX")"
    66	  local d
    67	  for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
    68	    [[ -d "$ROOT/$d" ]] || continue
    69	    ( cd "$ROOT" && find "$d" -type f -print )
    70	  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
    71	  if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then rm -f "$list"; die "a path under the suite holds a backslash"; fi
    72	  python3 -I - "$ROOT" "$list" > "$out" <<'PY' || { rm -f "$list"; die "hashing failed"; }
    73	import hashlib, os, sys
    74	root, listing = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    75	for rel in open(listing, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
    76	    if not rel:
    77	        continue
    78	    h = hashlib.sha256()
    79	    with open(os.path.join(root, rel), "rb") as f:
    80	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
    81	            h.update(b)
    82	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + rel)
    83	PY
    84	  rm -f "$list"
    85	}
    86	digest_of() { python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$1"; }

    88	TMP="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze.XXXXXX")"

    97	    exit 0
    98	  fi
    99	  echo "freeze: DRIFT against $MANIFEST:"

   102	def load(p):
   103	    m = {}
   104	    for line in open(p, encoding="utf-8"):
   105	        line = line.rstrip("\n")
   106	        if line:
   107	            h, _, rel = line.partition("  ")
   108	            m[rel] = h
   109	    return m
   110	old, new = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
   111	for rel in sorted(set(old) | set(new)):
   112	    if rel not in new:
   113	        print(f"  removed  {rel}")
   114	    elif rel not in old:
   115	        print(f"  added    {rel}")
   116	    elif old[rel] != new[rel]:
   117	        print(f"  changed  {rel}")
   118	PY
   119	  exit 1
   120	fi
   121

   125	#!/usr/bin/env bash
   126	# =============================================================================
   127	# fingerprint.sh — toolchain fingerprint for ablation runs (cycle-130 FR-4, SDD A11 / DEC-0389)
   128	#
   129	# Prints `fp:<sha256>` over the LC_ALL=C-sorted `tool=version` lines of the
   130	# toolchain an ablation run depends on (claude, codex, python3, node, yq, jq,
   131	# bats, git, docker) plus `source_tree=<HEAD of --source-tree>`. A tool that is
   132	# not installed reads `tool=absent`, so a missing tool changes the fingerprint
   133	# instead of failing the run. The value fills `image_digest` in host mode and
   134	# `fingerprint` in every mode (MANIFEST.json, pipeline.json, runs.jsonl). It reads the
   135	# HOST toolchain: in container mode the phases run on the image's toolchain, and the
   136	# image digest (not this value) identifies the batch's versions (on 2026-10-15 the host
   137	# CLI was 2.1.300 while Dockerfile.ablation pins 2.1.299).
   138	#
   139	# Usage:
   140	#   fingerprint.sh [--source-tree DIR] [--claude-bin B] [--bats-bin B] [--json]
   141	#
   142	# Options:
   143	#   --source-tree DIR  the pinned Loa tree; its `git rev-parse HEAD` is folded in
   144	#                      (`none` when absent or not a git tree)
   145	#   --claude-bin B     the CLI executable (default: $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
   146	#   --bats-bin B       bats executable (default: bats on PATH, else the operator's
   147	#                      ~/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats)
   148	#   --json             print {fingerprint, tools{}, source_tree, lines[]} instead
   149	#
   150	# Exit codes:
   151	#   0  printed
   152	#   2  usage error
   153	#
   154	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (fingerprint cases).
   155	# =============================================================================
   156	set -euo pipefail
   157	export LC_ALL=C
   158	
   159	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
   160	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
   161	
   162	SOURCE_TREE=""
   163	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
   164	BATS_BIN="${LOA_EVAL_BATS_BIN:-}"
   165	JSON=false
   166	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
   167	  case "$1" in
   168	    --source-tree) SOURCE_TREE="${2:?--source-tree needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
   169	    --claude-bin)  CLAUDE_BIN="${2:?--claude-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
   170	    --bats-bin)    BATS_BIN="${2:?--bats-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
   171	    --json)        JSON=true; shift ;;
   172	    -h|--help)     sed -n '2,28p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
   173	    *) echo "fingerprint.sh: unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
   174	  esac
   175	done

   177	  if command -v bats >/dev/null 2>&1; then BATS_BIN=bats
   178	  else BATS_BIN="$HOME/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats"; fi
   179	fi

   190	}

   195	    printf 'codex=%s\n'   "$(tool_version codex --version)"
   196	    printf 'python3=%s\n' "$(tool_version python3 --version)"
   197	    printf 'node=%s\n'    "$(tool_version node --version)"
   198	    printf 'yq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version yq --version)"
   199	    printf 'jq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version jq --version)"
   200	    printf 'bats=%s\n'    "$(tool_version "$BATS_BIN" --version)"
   201	    printf 'git=%s\n'     "$(tool_version git --version)"
   202	    printf 'docker=%s\n'  "$(tool_version docker --version)"
   203	  } | LC_ALL=C sort
   204	)"

   127	# fingerprint.sh — toolchain fingerprint for ablation runs (cycle-130 FR-4, SDD A11 / DEC-0389)

   163	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
   164	BATS_BIN="${LOA_EVAL_BATS_BIN:-}"

   166	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do

   219	  printf '%s\n' "$fp"
   220	fi
